metadata.description: Update an existing price book in your HubSpot account.
metadata.learn_more: Update an existing price book in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify details such as the name, description, supported currencies, and custom properties of a price book. It is useful for keeping your price book information up to date with the latest changes.

priceBookId.label: Price Book Id
priceBookId.description: The unique identifier of the price book to update.

customProperties.label: Custom Properties
customProperties.description: An object containing custom properties for the price book, where each key is a property name and the value is a string.

description.label: Description
description.description: An object representing the description of the price book to be updated.

name.label: Name
name.description: An object representing the name of the price book to be updated.

supportedCurrencies.label: Supported Currencies
supportedCurrencies.description: An array of strings representing the currencies supported by the price book.
